title: Delivery promotion
brief: Advertise free next-day delivery in the GTA for FreshSip orders over $25 this month.
clarifications: Which postal codes count as the GTA?
How is next-day calculated relative to the order cut-off time?
Does the $25 threshold apply before or after discounts?

requirements.title: Promise matches fulfilment
criteria: The landing page shows the offer only for postal codes the fulfilment eligibility service accepts.
The delivery fee at checkout agrees with the promise shown on the landing page.

test_plan: Postal-code eligibility table compared with fulfilment service responses
implementation_note: Template and preview only. These are not implemented end to end in this prototype.
